verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a published OpenAPI spec (openapi.json), machine-readable docs (llms.txt and Markdown mirrors), and an MCP server whose search()/execute() tools let agents call API endpoints. None of these documents an interactive API reference with runnable, try-it examples. A raw spec and an agent tool interface are building blocks or adjacent features, not the browsable, runnable reference the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
